annotation.title_clean: European Parliament and Council Directive 95/16/EC of 29 June 1995 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to lifts
annotation.title_en: European Parliament and Council Directive 95/16/EC of 29 June 1995 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to lifts
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 213
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 95/16/EC harmonises Member State laws on lifts permanently serving buildings and their safety components. It sets essential health and safety requirements, conformity assessment modules, CE marking, notified bodies and safeguard procedures. It contains no AI or robotics content and was later replaced by Directive 2014/33/EU.
key_provisions_or_claims: Lifts and safety components must meet essential health and safety requirements in Annex I
CE marking and EC declaration of conformity give presumption of conformity
Conformity assessment through notified bodies using type-examination, quality assurance and unit verification modules
Harmonized CEN/Cenelec standards give presumption of compliance
Member States must apply the rules from 1 July 1997 and may withdraw non-compliant products
